messages:
Alex: PagerDuty alert - control-plane-mesh health check failing in na-west1, auth tokens timing out, console 503s. Raising P1.
DevOps Bot: [ALERT] control-plane-mesh: error-rate spike 502/503 -> 72% in na-west1. pd_incident: PD-4481.
Maria: I'm seeing KV sync lag and heartbeats delayed. GPU fleet nodes still healthy but provisioning API returns 504 intermittently.
Jin: Can someone confirm if a BGP session flapped on our edge? Netops logs show peer flapped 3x at 03:12 UTC.
Infra SRE: Confirmed. BGP flap on na-west1 transit caused asymmetric routing to control-plane endpoints — fell back to congested path, causing authz timeouts and higher latency.
Katherine: Pausing all config rollouts in na-west1 per runbook. Recommend scaling control-plane replicas from 5 -> 8 as an immediate hedge. Who can trigger scale?
Alex: On it — running `kubectl -n controlplane scale deploy/controlplane --replicas=8 --context=na-west1` (will follow logs).
Alex: Deploy API accepted scale (202) but proxy sidecar pods are CrashLoopBackOff on a couple of replicas.
Infra SRE: Sidecar crash due to cert-agent failing to fetch KMS over the flaky route. Cert-agent times out -> TLS handshake error. Workaround: enable TLS local-cache fallback and restart cert-agent. Patching now.
Maria: Can we traffic-shift critical generation/auth traffic to na-east1 as temporary mitigation? Need to protect Hosted API latency and Dedicated provisioning. Propose 30% shift immediately.
Jin: Preparing route update. Will apply smart-routing change and enable emergency-fallback: `route update --policy smart --set na-west1=0.7,na-east1=0.3 --enable emergency-fallback`.
Alex: Applied route update and emergency-fallback flag. Metrics: auth error rate down from 72% -> 18% in 2 minutes. :thumbsup:
Console Service: Console frontends in na-west1 still showing 503 for ~50% of nodes; switching console reads to standby control-plane in na-east1 to restore dashboard access.
Katherine: Noting increased GPU provisioning latency for Dedicated customers in na-west1; autoscaler retries failing due to control-plane timeouts. Propose temp throttle for new provisioning to avoid exhaustion: 60% of normal ramp.
Maria: Drafting customer advisory now and coordinating with CS + sales. Also adding note to status page: "Partial control-plane degradation in na-west1; routing shifted; mitigation in progress."
Infra SRE: TLS fallback patch rolled, restarting cert-agent across controlplane pods. If BGP stabilizes and certs fetch succeeds, we can revert traffic-shift and resume paused rollouts.
Jin: Netops reports BGP peer re-established at 03:26 UTC; still seeing flaps but much reduced. Monitoring for 10m before full revert.
Alex: PD incident updated with timeline, root-cause hypothesis (edge BGP flap -> asymmetric paths -> KMS reachability -> cert-agent timeouts -> proxy crash -> auth/routing failures) and mitigation steps. Next: monitor 30m, prepare rollback plan if errors climb. Thanks all.
